en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town in a hilly landscape, taken from an elevated vantage point. A winding road and a narrow river run through the valley lined with two‑ and three‑story houses with steep gabled roofs. To the right stands a large Gothic‑style church with a tall spire; another church complex with towers is visible on a wooded slope to the left. The settlement is surrounded by open fields, scattered farm buildings, and forested hills in the background. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image side.
